units.source_text: 本来出身低微的寻常人，往往刻意模仿身份高贵的人而自尊自大。

en.t: Ordinary people of humble birth often deliberately imitate those of high rank and become proud and arrogant.

units.source_text: 末摘花的姨母呢，虽然出身于高贵世家，恐怕前生注定沦落为地方官太太，故其性情有些卑鄙。

en.t: As for Suetsumuhana's aunt, although she was born into a noble family, she must have been fated in a former life to sink to being the wife of a provincial official, and so her nature was somewhat mean.

units.source_text: 她想：“姐姐为我身份低微而侮辱我，现在她自己家里弄得这么困窘，也是报应。

en.t: She thought, "My elder sister insulted me because my rank was low, and now her own household has fallen into such hardship; this too is retribution.

units.source_text: 我要趁此机会叫她的女儿来替我的女儿当侍女呢。

en.t: I will take this chance to have her daughter come and serve as an attendant to my daughter.

units.source_text: 这妮子性情虽然古板，倒是个很可靠的管家。”

en.t: Though that girl is stiff and old-fashioned by nature, she would actually make a very reliable household manager."

units.source_text: 便命人传语：“请你常到我家来玩玩，这里的姑娘要听你弹琴呢。”

en.t: She then sent someone with a message: "Please come to my house often for visits; the young lady here wants to hear you play the koto."

units.source_text: 又时常催促侍从，要她陪小姐来。

en.t: She also frequently urged the attendant to accompany the young lady there.

units.source_text: 末摘花呢，倒并非有意骄人，只是异常怕羞，终于不曾前去亲近姨母。

en.t: As for Suetsumuhana, she did not mean to act haughty toward anyone; she was simply extremely shy, and in the end she never went to become close to her aunt.
